trust_decision.summary: An organisation owner fully controls the notification destination URL, and that URL is trusted to be a public HTTP(S) endpoint only where the fix enforces it: in WebhookForm/SlackForm and in the _http_post_json sink of the web 'Try' path; the scheduler that actually delivers notifications trusts the stored URL with no check at all.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading 'SSRF in notifications' searches for outbound requests and finds the only one in the web app: _http_post_json's urllib urlopen, reached from both WebhookNotificationTester and SlackNotificationTester.

fix_sites.entry_point: n/a - new shared library module imported by the web app
shared helper used by WebhookForm.clean_url and SlackForm.clean_webhook_url
POST /org/<org>/projects/<project>/notifications/add?type=webhook and .../notifications/<notification> (action=try and plain save), via NotificationCreateView/NotificationUpdateView
same two routes with type=slack, via SlackForm

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Airflow scheduler is a separate service and package from the web app; the advisory and its diff are about the notification form/Try button, and the scheduler was not touched, so its delivery code looks like someone else's scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The Try must keep POSTing the user's JSON payload and custom headers (including Authorization) to any public endpoint and must keep returning that endpoint's status, headers and body to the UI; a blanket 'block anything non-Slack / block redirects / strip headers' fix breaks it, and in DEBUG the webhook URL is accepted without a scheme (assume_scheme=http) so validating raw POST data instead of cleaned_data rejects legitimate input.

O6_input_shapes: public hostname whose DNS answer is a private IP
mixed DNS answers where at least one IP is private
IPv4 literals: loopback, RFC1918, link-local 169.254.169.254, multicast, reserved, 0.0.0.0
IPv6 literals: ::1, fe80::/10, fc00::/7 unique-local, ::ffff: IPv4-mapped
missing hostname and invalid or out-of-range port
redirect responses (301/302/303/307/308), relative Location, and chains longer than 3
DNS rebinding between validation and connect (pinned getaddrinfo per thread)

O7_producer.where: scheduler/dags/includes/tasks/automations/actions.py:205-236 (SQL_NOTIFICATION_BY_ID / build_notifications_cache at scheduler/dags/includes/tasks/automations/__init__.py:877-900 loading notifications.configuration into notification_conf)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Automation 'send_notification' action: the scheduler loads the stored notification configuration and WebhookNotifier POSTs extras.url with aiohttp, with no scheme/host/IP validation and no redirect revalidation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the Airflow/delivery side of a notification, a different service from the form the report talks about.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: across the web -> scheduler package boundary via the Postgres notifications.configuration column

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Automation 'send_notification' action for Slack: SlackNotifier POSTs the stored extras.webhook_url with aiohttp, unvalidated
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Slack webhooks are 'supposed' to point at hooks.slack.com, so the channel looks like a trusted-host case rather than an SSRF surface.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same boundary; the report's Slack example is the form field, not this notifier

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fourth channel type (e.g. teams/discord) added to FORM_MAPPING whose form has a URL field but no clean_<field> hook
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FORM_MAPPING, not the form class, is what wires form fields into notification extras, so a maintainer adding a channel edits the mapping and the form and can easily forget the separate validator hook that the fix adds.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new notifier class next to WebhookNotifier/SlackNotifier that POSTs to another config URL with its own aiohttp call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The notifier module is the established place to add a transport; EmailNotifier shows the pattern of one class per type, and a copy of WebhookNotifier.send inherits the missing validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new tester registered in NOTIFICATION_TRY_REGISTRY that opens its own transport instead of calling _http_post_json
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The registry dispatch is the natural extension point for a new channel, and the published sink check only protects testers that funnel through _http_post_json.
